annotation.cut_point:
We are given the following:

- **One bag of grass seed covers 250 square feet.**
- **Drew bought 4 bags**, so the total area he covered is:
  $$
  4 \times 250 = 1000 \text{ square feet}
  $$

- He had **enough seed to cover an extra 208 square feet**, meaning the **actual area of the lawn is**:
  $$
  1000 + 208 = 1208 \text{ square feet}
  $$
